description: Every Hudu cmdlet, plus an offline SQLite mirror, cross-entity audits, and agent-native output no PowerShell module or read-only MCP ships.
auth_description:
Raw Hudu API key sent as the `x-api-key` header (no Bearer prefix). Create it in
the Hudu portal: Admin -> API Keys. Also set HUDU_BASE_URL to your instance's
/api/v1 URL. Keys may be global or company-scoped; company-scoped keys cannot
call the global `assets list` endpoint (use `assets list-by-company`).

novel_features.name: Documentation-completeness score
novel_features.description: Score how completely each company's assets fill their layout's required fields, worst-first.

novel_features.name: Stale-password audit
novel_features.description: Find vault passwords not rotated within a threshold, grouped by company.

novel_features.name: Expiration radar
novel_features.description: Windowed, typed view of expiring SSL certs, domains, warranties, and passwords sorted by days remaining.

novel_features.name: Multi-tenant hygiene rollup
novel_features.description: One worst-first hygiene scorecard per company combining completeness, stale passwords, expirations due, and stale articles.

novel_features.name: Onboarding scaffold
novel_features.description: Preview (default) and apply with --apply a saved bundle of asset layouts, folder tree, and procedures-from-template to a new company; the write path needs a global (not company-scoped) API key.

novel_features.name: Integration reconciliation report
novel_features.description: Bulk bidirectional check of which integrator (PSA/RMM) records resolve to a live Hudu asset and which are orphaned.

novel_features.name: Tenant doctor / preflight
novel_features.description: Check CLI health: config, auth, API reachability, credential presence, and local-cache freshness.

novel_features.name: Layout-drift detector
novel_features.description: Find assets carrying custom fields not in their layout's current schema, or missing newly-added fields.

novel_features.name: Article-staleness audit
novel_features.description: Rank knowledge-base articles by how long since they were last updated.

novel_features.name: Resolve by URL or name
novel_features.description: Paste a Hudu object URL or exact name and get the object plus its company, layout, and relations.
